in_marathi.name: Surajraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Surajraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Surajraj is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Suraj' meaning sun and 'Raj' meaning king. The name Surajraj signifies the ruler of the sun and represents the power and authority of the sun.
